improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your AI-powered trade and business assistant. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for traders and business owners. Try three free searches today.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace for traders and professionals. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | AI Assistant for Trade & Business">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Professional AI support for business owners and traders. Try Gideon free.">
improvements.rationale: Search engines and social platforms use meta descriptions and OG tags to generate previews. A clear, benefit-focused meta description improves click-through rates from search results. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the site is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial offer creates a low-friction call to action without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice-powered support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three searches free — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline introduces Gideon by name while clearly positioning it as an AI partner for trade and business, immediately qualifying the target audience. The subheading highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) and removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no commitment. This builds trust and encourages immediate engagement with the product.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's trade and business intelligence, voice chat, and your personal members workspace. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point—the paywall after the free trial. By explaining the transition clearly and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and value, it reduces uncertainty and encourages conversion rather than abandonment.
